APPROVE
`Files` now has a cognitive complexity of about 4 (the `while`, the `&&`, and one nested `if`), and the behaviour is unchanged: the per-file `break` still exits only the entry loop before subdirectories are queued, and every failure path still goes to `unread`. The `CHA0004` pragmas are correctly re-paired around the new helpers. I couldn't find the source here to build it, so a clean build assumes `wanted` is a `Func<string, bool>`, `files` is a `List<(string Relative, string Text)>`, and the project's C# version supports `[]` collection expressions.
